newsitem.title: USA: Florida allocates $45 million to Miami port.
newsitem.headline: Florida allocates $45 million to Miami port.

text.p: The state of Florida announced Thursday that it would allocate $45 million in transportation funds to the port of Miami for the development of Maritime Park, a cruise facility expansion.

A state spokesman said a coalition of 14 deep-water ports had lobbied the state legislature for bonds to improve and expand port facilities across Florida. A $250 million bond issue was recent allocated to those ports.

As part of the coalition, the port of Miami was to receive $45 million and will match that amount to generate $90 million. The money will be used for the first phase of construction on Maritime Park, creating two new cruise terminals.
When complete, Maritime Park will add four cruise ship terminals and eight berths, enabling the port to handle 12 more ships per week, the officials said.
